# What should you charge per acre to spray with a drone?

> Free spray drone quote calculator for custom applicators. Enter your drone, batteries, costs and a list of fields; get the real time on each field, cost per acre, a recommended quote, minimum-charge check and season break-even. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
